map.净利率（本页代码口径）：净利率=净利润÷营业收入×100（%）；联动量：年化净利: Net margin (actual code on this page): net margin = net profit ÷ operating revenue × 100 (%); linked values: annualised net margin = net margin × 12, total costs and expenses = operating revenue − net profit, net margin as a decimal = net profit ÷ (operating revenue||1). Validation: both fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Rule: no fixed grading; net margin is proportional to net profit and inversely proportional to operating revenue, and the main result keeps 2 decimal places.
map.净利率（本页代码口径）：净利率=净利润÷营业收入×100（%）；联动量：净利率小: Net profit margin (this page's code definition): net margin = net profit ÷ operating revenue × 100 (%). Linked values: decimal margin = net profit ÷ revenue; revenue minus net profit difference. Validation: net profit and revenue are required finite numbers; when revenue is 0 the ratio shows "Not applicable". Rule: no annualisation is performed, and net profit and revenue must cover the same period; revenue minus net profit includes non-operating gains/losses and income tax, so it is not the same as total costs and expenses.
map.净利润与营业收入须为同一期间；本页不做年化，收入为 0 时比率不适用。: Net profit and revenue must cover the same period; this page does not annualize, and the ratio is not applicable when revenue is 0.
map.为什么不能把净利率乘以 12 当年化？: Why can the net margin not be multiplied by 12 to annualize it?
map.净利率是同一期间的净利润÷营业收入，比率本身与期间长度无关；没有输入周期时直接×: The net margin is net profit ÷ revenue for the same period, and the ratio itself is independent of period length. Without a period input, multiplying by 12 would misreport a monthly 10% as 120%, so this page does not annualize.
